annotations.title: Record that a quote was accepted

description: Records on a sale quote or a purchase order that the other party accepted it: accepted_at (now, or the moment the user gives) and accepted_by, who accepted. A dated fact on the document — nothing is booked — and its quote_status becomes accepted. Where the crm module holds a deal that carries this quote, the deal is won by the database itself, and its party becomes a customer. Refused by name on an invoice (document_not_answerable), on a declined quote (document_already_answered: undo_document_answer first), for a moment to come (answer_in_the_future). The database holds you to the company's agent_posting as for a posting: in review, only once a person approved the quote as it stands (approval_required otherwise); in autopilot, directly; recorded on the audit trail as an agent's. Ask the user before calling it. This session follows each company's agent_posting.

accepted_by.description: Who accepted it, in the user's words: a name, a role, the reference of a signed copy.

at.description: When the other party answered: an ISO date or timestamp, as the user says it. Left out: now. Never in the future (answer_in_the_future).

document_id.description: The sale quote or purchase order the other party accepted.
